note: Rendered by the policy skill with AskUserQuestion (max 4 questions per call). The previous answer, when one exists, is moved to the first option and labelled (previous). Nothing is ever reused silently.

questions.question: How much user data may Sentry collect from this app?

options.label: Strict
options.description: No user info, IP, cookies, headers, request/response bodies, DB query values or local variables. Only what you add by hand.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Error context and breadcrumbs, a hashed or opaque user id, no IP, cookies, auth headers or bodies. Recommended for most products.

options.label: Permissive
options.description: SDK defaults with user info and IP. Only for internal tools or when users have consented.

options.label: Custom
options.description: I will set each dimension (user, IP, cookies/headers, bodies, query data, local variables, screenshots) myself.

questions.question: May Sentry record AI prompts and model outputs? (Server-side scrubbing does not cover gen_ai fields.)

options.label: Off
options.description: Record model, tokens, latency and tool calls, never the prompt or output text.

options.label: Redacted
options.description: Record text only after the app's own redaction hook runs.

options.label: On
options.description: Record full prompts and outputs. Only if the data may be stored by Sentry.

questions.question: How should Session Replay mask the UI?

options.label: Mask everything
options.description: Mask all text and inputs and block media (the SDK default).

options.label: Inputs only
options.description: Mask form inputs; show static text. Review each screen for personal data first.

options.label: No masking
options.description: Only for apps with no user-generated or personal content.

questions.question: What may this plugin do in your Sentry organization?

options.label: Read only
options.description: Audit org settings, alerts, monitors, releases. Nothing is changed.

options.label: Read + approved writes
options.description: Also create projects, monitors and alerts, one exact API call at a time, each shown and approved first.

options.label: No org access
options.description: Repo-only work. Every org-side check is reported UNVERIFIED.

questions.question: Which environments should send events to Sentry?

options.label: production
options.description: Real users.

options.label: staging
options.description: Pre-release testing; usually lower sample rates.

options.label: development (Spotlight)
options.description: Local only through Spotlight; nothing is billed.

questions.question: Roughly how much traffic, and is a pay-as-you-go budget set? (Logs, metrics and profiling overage need one.)

options.label: Low traffic, no budget
options.description: Keep rates conservative; skip logs, metrics and profiling unless free quota covers them.

options.label: Medium traffic, budget set
options.description: Tracing at 10-20%, logs on errors and warnings, profiling sampled.

options.label: High traffic, budget set
options.description: Use a traces sampler: keep critical routes, drop health checks, sample the rest low.

options.label: Not sure
options.description: Use conservative rates and show the numbers so you can adjust.

questions.question: Who creates releases and uploads source maps / debug files?

options.label: CI
options.description: A CI job on each deploy with an organization auth token in the secret store.

options.label: Vercel / host integration
options.description: The hosting integration handles releases.

options.label: Local machine
options.description: A manual or Makefile step (macOS apps, small projects).

options.label: Nobody yet
options.description: Set it up as part of this run.

questions.question: Any products to force on or off? (Defaults come from what the repo shows.)

options.label: Use detected defaults
options.description: No overrides.

options.label: Also logs
options.description: Add Sentry Logs even without a detected logging library.

options.label: Never replay
options.description: Mark Session Replay not wanted.

options.label: Never profiling
options.description: Mark profiling not wanted.
